name: scholaraio-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is ScholarAIO, an academic-library toolkit for coding agents: a local paper store
(one directory per paper with `meta.json` and `paper.md`), a SQLite FTS5 keyword index with filters and citation-graph
queries, layered reading, BibTeX / RIS / Markdown export with citation styles, citation checking, workspaces, library
WebUI services, audit, insights, metrics, rsync backup and the `scholaraio` command line.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is these Python modules of the scholaraio package: scholaraio/core/config.py and log.py; scholaraio/stores/papers.py, citation_styles.py, proceedings.py and explore.py; scholaraio/projects/workspace.py; scholaraio/services/index.py, chunks.py, export.py, citation_check.py, library_search.py, library_view.py, audit.py, loader.py, backup.py, insights.py, metrics.py and ingest/identifiers.py; and scholaraio/interfaces/cli/arguments.py, audit.py, backup.py, citation_check.py, citations.py, compat.py, explore.py, export.py, fsearch.py, graph.py, gui.py, index.py, insights.py, metrics.py, output.py, paper.py, parser.py, paths.py, proceedings.py, rename.py, repair.py, retrieval.py, runtime.py, search.py, search_metrics.py, show.py, style.py and workspace.py. Together with them, the documentation pages docs/getting-started/configuration.md, docs/guide/cli-reference.md, docs/guide/insights.md and docs/guide/search.md, and the module, class and function docstrings
